trust_boundaries_STRIDE.spoofing: Caller must independently identify/pin child and output sinks. Helper does not authorize child, owner, token or migration.
trust_boundaries_STRIDE.tampering: Source/member/base hashes verified. Fixed explicit std-handle allowlist; private bytearray uses ctypes from_buffer without explicit immutable content copy. Caller must exclusively own plain bytearray until return.
trust_boundaries_STRIDE.repudiation: Result records pipe/setup/lifecycle booleans and actual exit only. No tests were run by reviewer; source author's six cases remain pending actual evidence.
trust_boundaries_STRIDE.information_disclosure: Private data excluded from helper commandline/environment/result; child output remains caller-controlled. Original pipe handles noninheritable; write end closed before launch; only read duplicate plus stdout/stderr enter child handle list. Root caller must avoid concurrent broad-inheritance process creation while inheritable duplicates exist.
trust_boundaries_STRIDE.denial_of_service: Unverified requested capacity followed by synchronous prelaunch WriteFile is not bounded by the helper's deadline checks. See acceptance blocker; actual host deadlock not reproduced.
trust_boundaries_STRIDE.elevation: CREATE_SUSPENDED then exclusive KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE Job assignment before ResumeThread retained. No token/signing/private-owner bridge implemented.

acceptance_blockers.description: 65536 is a requested buffer size, not a verified guarantee. The synchronous WriteFile runs before reader-child creation and before any timeout check. If capacity is insufficient, the same thread cannot reach timeout/wipe/close. A passing4096 smoke case proves one instance, not a per-call invariant.
acceptance_blockers.evidence: Microsoft CreatePipe docs state nSize is a suggestion and full-buffer WriteFile waits for a reader. Source has no GetNamedPipeInfo or PeekNamedPipe.
acceptance_blockers.recommendation: Before creating a ctypes private-input view or writing, query actual anonymous pipe info through read handle; verify byte pipe, select correct direction from server/client flags, require reported nonzero capacity at least payload length, and confirm zero queued bytes using PeekNamedPipe with NULL data buffer. Keep sole unshared prelaunch writer/read handles. Fail closed before WriteFile/child on query failure, zero/unknown capacity, insufficient capacity or nonempty pipe. Check remaining time before/after preload. Retain outer owned-process deadline; native API calls are not a strict hard real-time guarantee.
acceptance_blockers.validation: Root public dummy normal/4096/nonzeroexit/timeout/bounds cases plus pre-write refusal checks for failed/unknown/short capacity and nonempty reports; assert caller wipe, no resumed child and closed handles. No real Owner required.

observations.description: Normalized text comparison passes; raw byte comparison fails due to different line endings.
observations.recommendation: State normalized-line-ending comparison accurately or preserve the original line endings.

observations.description: Public probe argv does not pass isolated/no-site/no-bytecode Python flags; environment minimization alone does not establish child Python import closure.
observations.recommendation: Use explicit -I -S -B for the fixed public probe interpreter and run verifier with bytecode writes disabled; retain source/DLL inventory guard. This is a test-closure improvement, not evidence of private credential exposure.

cleanup_static_review.validation_reject: Outer finally clears accepted bytearray even on invalid size; no child/native handles created before validation.

cleanup_static_review.file_type_or_view_failure: Both successful pipe handles registered; outer finally wipes bytearray and closes handles.
cleanup_static_review.write_failure: Inner finally wipes buffer and drops ctypes view; outer closes pipe/job. A never-returning write remains the unresolved boundary.
cleanup_static_review.writer_close_failure: No child creation occurs; handles remain tracked and cleanup records any close errors.
cleanup_static_review.duplicate_or_attribute_or_create_failure: Tracked pipe/duplicate/job handles close; attribute list deleted if initialized.
cleanup_static_review.created_unassigned_failure: Original suspended-child termination path retained; no thread resume before Job assignment.
cleanup_static_review.assigned_timeout_or_failure: Original TerminateJobObject and bounded five-second primary-exit/job-idle observation retained.
cleanup_static_review.normal_return: Original handles closed; caller-owned stdout/stderr remain open. Wiping sets bytes to zero but does not guarantee OS pagefile/kernel residual eradication.
cleanup_static_review.scope_limit: Static branch analysis only; no injected OS failures executed.

public_test_source.timeout_case_limit: Checks child-phase Job termination; does not inject or bound prelaunch WriteFile stall.
public_test_source.probe_eof: Read4097 with max4096 then successful return checks EOF; result is not credential content.
